# Getting Started

::::steps

## Install

:::code-group

```bash [pnpm]
pnpm add lexical-footnote
```

```bash [npm]
npm i lexical-footnote
```

:::

## Register the extension

```tsx twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"80db2433e190e5e676fd4441457e3aad3c5cf89d30eab909241ba529ee956fa8","data":""}
import {buildEditorFromExtensions} from '@lexical/extension';
import {FootnoteExtension} from 'lexical-footnote';

const editor = buildEditorFromExtensions({
  dependencies: [FootnoteExtension],
  name: 'my-editor',
  namespace: 'my-app',
});
```

## Type a footnote

Type `[^note]` anywhere in the body — the cue materializes and an empty
note heals into the footnote section, ready to be written.

::::

## Optional entry points

| Entry                         | What it adds                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lexical-footnote/mdast`      | [GFM markdown round-trip](/docs/markdown) via `@lexical/mdast` — [API](/docs/api/mdast)                             |
| `lexical-footnote/clipboard`  | [Paste from Word / Google Docs / GitHub](/docs/clipboard), and copy that carries notes — [API](/docs/api/clipboard) |
| `lexical-footnote/styles.css` | [The default stylesheet](/docs/styling) for the footnote anatomy                                                    |
